schema.name: DatadogLogs_CL
schema.description: Indexed Datadog logs collected from the Datadog Logs Search API

columns.name: EventId
columns.description: Unique identifier of the Datadog log event

columns.name: EventType
columns.description: Resource type of the event (always 'log')

columns.name: Attributes
columns.description: Full attributes object of the Datadog log event

columns.name: LogAttributes
columns.description: Custom attributes associated with the Datadog log event

columns.name: Host
columns.description: Host that generated the log event

columns.name: Message
columns.description: Log message

columns.name: Service
columns.description: Application or service that generated the log event

columns.name: Status
columns.description: Status or severity associated with the log event

columns.name: Tags
columns.description: Tags associated with the log event

columns.name: EventTimestamp
columns.description: Timestamp reported by Datadog for the log event

columns.name: LogAttributeId
columns.description: Source-specific identifier in the log attributes

columns.name: LogAttributeTimestamp
columns.description: Source timestamp from the log attributes

columns.name: Level
columns.description: Source-specific log level

columns.name: LambdaArn
columns.description: ARN of the AWS Lambda function that generated the log

columns.name: AwsDetails
columns.description: AWS metadata associated with the log event

columns.name: AwsAccountId
columns.description: AWS account identifier associated with the log

columns.name: AwsInvokedFunctionArn
columns.description: ARN of the AWS Lambda function invoked by the integration

columns.name: AwsLogGroup
columns.description: AWS CloudWatch log group

columns.name: AwsLogStream
columns.description: AWS CloudWatch log stream

columns.name: AwsS3Bucket
columns.description: S3 bucket containing the source log

columns.name: AwsS3Key
columns.description: S3 object key containing the source log

columns.name: NetworkDetails
columns.description: Network metadata associated with the log event

columns.name: BytesWritten
columns.description: Number of bytes written during the network flow

columns.name: ClientIp
columns.description: Source IP address of the network flow

columns.name: ClientPort
columns.description: Source port of the network flow

columns.name: DestinationIp
columns.description: Destination IP address of the network flow

columns.name: DestinationPort
columns.description: Destination port of the network flow

columns.name: NetworkInterface
columns.description: AWS network interface associated with the flow

columns.name: PacketCount
columns.description: Number of packets in the network flow

columns.name: NetworkProtocol
columns.description: IP protocol number of the network flow

columns.name: VpcDetails
columns.description: Amazon VPC flow metadata

columns.name: VpcAction
columns.description: Action applied to the VPC network flow

columns.name: VpcIntervalStart
columns.description: Start time of the VPC flow interval

columns.name: VpcIntervalEnd
columns.description: End time of the VPC flow interval

columns.name: VpcStatus
columns.description: Status of the VPC flow log record

columns.name: VpcVersion
columns.description: Version of the VPC flow log format
